'''2011 Belgium Regionals Cedrik Vanderhaegen DS Kashyyyk''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
